scientific_intent.scientific_task: Find exact k nearest reference vectors for every query using Euclidean distance, returning ordered distances and reference indices
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: All-pairs squared L2distance, stable per-query insertion topk, then square root of selected distances. Exact ties retain ascending original reference index.
scientific_intent.discretization: Dimension-major finite feature vectors, no physical mesh. Cases129reference×67queries×68dimensions,k20 native-seeded random;65×37×5,k7 signed dyadic repeated reference/query patterns.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: All1599 selected distances within originalsource1e-3absolute tolerance vs independentFloat64L2; all1599 referenceindices exact vs independent lexicographic(distance,index)sort. Original native CPUknn_c also passes. All20 raw artifacts preserve complete public outputs with no canonicalization.
scientific_intent.input_size_regime: Two complete search problems, including featuretail68mod16=4 andpartialpoint/query blocks; source4096²default not measured. Ten complete repeated batches, each2full searches with application allocations/transfers/frees inside.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Float32 feature/distance arithmetic and Int32indices, independentFloat64 pairwisesums and sqrt. Random case has nonzero cutoff gap; repeated-point case verifies exactties and stable index policy. Rawmixed Float64artifacts losslessly encode actual Float32distances/Int32indices, not Float64GPUcomputation.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Vector retrieval and feature matching are supported by explicit kNNsource/provenance. This primitive could support scientific data analysis or machine learning, but no classifiertraining/accuracy, feature extraction or downstreamscientific application is implemented.
scientific_intent.description: Complete brute-force exact nearest-neighbor search, not a distance-only subkernel. Both returned distances and ordered neighboridentities are checked against independent mathematical search and sourceCPU.
scientific_intent.provenance: OriginalCUDA contains tiled distance, insertion-topk andsqrt kernels plus complete allocate/copy/free wrapper. Historical CUDAjl was an unrelated sqrt-touch placeholder with hardcoded accuracy; preserved and replaced with fullsource-equivalent pipeline. KA/JACC translate this actualalgorithm after source review.
